decisions.rule: the kernel the op dispatches to computes other values than the op's own native definition on the same input
decisions.note: fused_gdn_gating (sglang.kernels.ops.attention.fla.fused_gdn_gating:fused_gdn_gating) on 64 of 256 rows of its first real call, against entail's definition (g = -exp(A_log) * softplus(a + dt_bias), beta = sigmoid(b)): max |kernel - definition| 16.6 over 4096 values; the definition's own noise 0.138 (typical 0.013); scale 17.6; 3457 values beyond FACTOR 8 x noise + 4 ulp (float32, float32); worst ratio to the allowance 151; worst value at output 0 index 506: kernel -20.97, definition -4.406, reference -4.393, allowed 0.109; not repaired: the function was called inside a CUDA graph capture in this process, and the graph replays the kernel whatever the name says
